strategy.name: slow-exit v4 (paper-trading candidate)
strategy.entry_rule: Buy-stop at the signal-day high, valid for the next session only.
strategy.exit_rule: Exit at the next open after a daily close below EMA50, or after 120 trading days.
strategy.stop_rule: Hard stop = signal close - max(1.5 x ATR, 3% of close), fixed at entry.

outcomes.note: Win/loss counts are descriptive. Below ~100 closed signals they say little about the criteria; winners run under a slow exit, so early closed-only results skew to stops.

summary.note: Signal-level R includes every signal, taken or not. Closed-only averages are biased toward losers for months, because stops hit fast while winners stay open under the slow exit; read the figure that includes open trades (marked to the last close) alongside it. Interval is naive (signals cluster by date); fewer than ~100 closed trades says almost nothing about expectancy.
